sections.heading: What We Collect
content: **Account information** (optional): Name, email address, and password if you create an account. You can use Geetanjali without an account.

**Consultation content**: The questions you ask and the guidance generated in response, stored on our server with or without an account. Only the account or browser tab that created a consultation can open it; a guest loses access when that tab is closed. If you share a consultation, anyone with the link can read it.
**Preferences**: Learning goals, reading progress, favorites, and theme settings. Stored in your browser for guests, and synced to your account if registered.
**Newsletter**: If you subscribe, your email address and subscription details are stored on our server.
**Usage data**: Basic server logs (IP address, request timestamps) for security and reliability, and anonymous page-visit and event counts from a third-party analytics service that sets no cookies.

sections.heading: How Your Data Is Processed
content: Your questions are sent to a third-party AI service to generate guidance. Your name, email, and account details are not sent with them.
Emails such as the newsletter and account verification are sent through a third-party email service. Error reports go to a third-party error-monitoring service.

sections.heading: What We Don't Do
content: We do not sell or rent your personal data, or share it for marketing or advertising.
We do not use your consultations to train AI models.
We do not track you across websites. We use no advertising cookies, tracking pixels, or fingerprinting.

sections.heading: Storage & Cookies
content: Data is stored on our server at a cloud hosting provider. Connections are encrypted with HTTPS, and passwords are hashed with bcrypt.

Your browser stores your preferences, reading progress, any unsent consultation draft, and a session identifier. These are not cookies. The identifier is sent with each request so our server can tell which consultations are yours. Clearing your browser data removes them, but not consultations stored on our server.
If you sign in, we set two cookies: an HTTP-only authentication cookie and a CSRF security token. Both are required while you are signed in. No third-party cookies are set.

sections.heading: Your Rights
content: **Export**: Settings exports the data kept in your browser (favorites, reading progress, preferences). Consultations are not included.
**Delete**: In Settings you can delete the data kept in your browser and, if registered, your account. Deleting your account removes your consultations and preferences.

If you are in the EU, UK, or another jurisdiction with data protection laws, you have additional rights including the right to access, rectify, and erase your personal data. Contact us to exercise these rights.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
content: We may update this policy. The date at the top of this page shows when it last changed.
